aboutPage.title: Global fashion. A simpler way to shop.
aboutPage.intro: Choose your item and pay in UZS. After payment, AVERON purchases it from the international seller and arranges delivery to Uzbekistan.
aboutPage.step1Text: Explore clothing, shoes, and accessories from the countries available in our catalog.
aboutPage.step2Text: Product listings are reviewed before publication, and your price is shown in UZS.
aboutPage.step3Text: After payment, we purchase the item from the seller and keep you updated on delivery.
aboutPage.principleTitle: International shopping, without the extra steps
aboutPage.principleText: We handle purchasing from the international seller and follow your order through delivery to Uzbekistan. Your price is shown in UZS, and order updates are available in your account.
aboutPage.ctaText: Explore the catalog and find your next look.
